name: Dr. Dipayan Ghosh
qualification: MBBS, DNB (General Surgery), M.Ch (Cardiovascular and Thoracic surgery)
description_html:
Dr. Dipayan Ghosh, a renowned Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgeon with two decades of experience, has recently become a Visiting Consultant at ILS Hospitals, specializing in CTVS.

Dr. Dipayan holds the position of Associate Professor in the Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery department at Calcutta Medical College & Hospital, Kolkata.

He completed his MBBS at N.R.S Medical College in 1996, followed by DNB (Gen. Surgery) at V.I.M.S, Kolkata in 2004, and Mch.(CTVS) at R.G.Kar Medical College & Hospital, Kolkata in 2014.

name: Dr. Amit jain
description_html:
Education and Training

  • MBBS, Pt. JNM Medical College Raipur, 2005
  • MS General Surgery,Pt.JNM Medical College Raipur,2011
  • MCh(Neurosurgery),IPGME&R Kolkata,2016
  • Fellowship in Endoscopic Brain And Spine Surgery,Jabalpur MP,2016

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

  • Certificate of Merit for Opthalmology during MBBS,2004
  • Was ranked 4th in First Chhattisgarh State Pre Medical Test(PMT-2001) and was rewarded for the same by Shri Digvijay Singh Ji.
  • Observership at Dept. Of Neurosurgery, AIIMS, New Delhi, 2015
  • Awarded 1st prize in the award paper presentation during ”RAJASTHAN NEUROSCIENCES UPDATE 2022” AIIMS Jodhpur, 2022
  • Cadaveric training in Cranio-verterbral junction (C-V Junction) surgery, Mumbai, 2017 and Cervico-dorsal junction surgery, Lucknow,2018

Experience

  • Assistant Professor, Department of Neurosurgery, Dr. B.R.A.M.Hospital, Raipur, C.G. (2016-2018)
  • Assistant Professor, Department of Neurosurgery, D.K.S.Superspeciality Hospital, Raipur, C.G. (2018-2022)
  • Associate Professor, Department of Neurosurgery, D.K.S.Superspeciality Hospital, Raipur, C.G. (2022- till date)
  • On call consultant in various Private Hospitals

Training and Confrences attended

  • SONCON-2024, 22nd MPCG NEUROCON, 9-10 November 2024,Ujjain, M.P.
  • NSSA SPINE 2024, 27th Annual Conference, 19-22 Sept 2024,Hyderabad
  • NSSICON 2024, AIIMS RAIPUR, 23-25 Feb 2024
  • NSSA SPINE, Cadaveric and live spine surgery workshop,Rajkot,Gujarat,27-28 Jan 2024
  • ISPNSCON 2024,AIIMS Raipur 12-14 Jan 2024
  • The 18th World Congress of Neurosurgery, WFNS 2023 CAPE TOWN, SOUTH AFRICA,4-8 December 2023
  • MPCG Neurocon 2023,September 2023, Raipur C.G.
  • NSICON 2022,Agra, December 2022
  • RAJASTHAN NEUROSCIENCES UPDATE 2022” AIIMS, Jodhpur, 7-8 October,2022
  • NEUROVASCON 2022,AIIMS Raipur, 23-25 September 2022
  • TSSULA-2022, 25-26 March 2022
  • NSSICON 2020, Kolkata, 27-29Feb.2020
  • 19th WFNS, Beijing, China 9-12 Sep.2019
  • CME and live workshop, Minimal invasive spine surgeons association of Bharat (Missab) Vadodara, 20th July 2019
  • SNVICON Mumbai 2019, 14-16 June 19
  • Cranial Endoscopy Workshop, AIIMS, New Delhi, 6-7th April 2019
  • NSICON 2018, Jaipur
  • 5th Minimaly Invasive Brain and Spine workshop, Jabalpur, 3-4th Nov.2018
  • Neurotrauma 2018, KGMC Lucknow, 16th August 2018
  • 2018 AO Spine Advanced Seminar, Raipur 24 Nov.2018
  • NSICON 2017, Nagpur (30 Nov.- 3Dec.2017
  • Skull Basecon 2017 Kochi, 27-29 October 2017
  • Prof Ramani’s Spine Master’s Teaching Course 2017,Mumbai, 21-23April 2017
  • Neuro Endoscopy Fellowship, Jabalpur, September 2016
  • SAANVI -2016 (Stroke and Advanced Neurovascular Intervention), 9-10April 2016
  • WFNS Skull Base Neuro Endoscopy Workshop, 25-26Nov 2015
  • Neurosurgery Skills Training Programme, AIIMS,New Delhi, 4Nov -18Nov 2015

Presented

  • “Postoperative clinical and radiological assessment of Basilar Invagination”, 22nd MPCG NEUROCON, 9-10 November 2024, Ujjain, M.P.
  • “My experience in Cranio-vertebral Junction Surgery” CME, CAN, 7th June 2024, Bhilai, C.G.
  • “ Atlanto-axial fixation for Type 2 Odontoid Fracture” E Poster presentation , The 18th World Congress of Neurosurgery, WFNS 2023 CAPE TOWN, SOUTH AFRICA, 4-8 December 2023
  • “Posterior C1C2 Fixation for Type 2 Odontoid Fracture” MPCG Neurocon 2023, Raipur C.G.
  • “An Atypical Hangman’s fracture with Atlantoaxial instability managed by C1-C2 Arthrodesis.” RAJASTHAN NEUROSCIENCES UPDATE 2022” AIIMS, Jodhpur, 7-8 October,2022
  • “Management of Cranio-vertebral junction abnormalities” CME, CAN Raipur, 19 November 2019

Research and Publication

    • Thesis (MCh Neurosurgery, Session- 2013-2016)-

“Anterior Cervical Corpectomy In Cervical Degenerative Disease with Fusion with or without Instrumentation”
Department of Neurosurgery, Bangur Institute Of Neurosciences and Institute Of Post Gratuate Medical Education And Research, Kolkata, West Bengal.

Papers

  • 1. Anterior skull base fractures and their management- An experience of 89 cases.Dr. Sanjeev Kumar, Dr. Debabrata Sahana, Dr. Rajiv Sahu, Dr.Amit Jain International Journal of Scientific Research Vol-6|Issue-8|Aug 2017
  • Use of subdural drains for management of chronic subdural hematoma after burr holes craniostomy.Dr. Sanjeev Kumar, Dr. Debabrata Sahana, Dr. Rajiv Sahu, Dr. Amit Jain, Dr. Deepak Singh International Journal Of Scientific Research Vol-6|Issue-8|Aug 2017
  • ETV for aqueductal stenosis in children between 6-12 months of age.Sharma Shipra, Sahu Rajiv, Sahana Debabrata, Gupta Gaurav, Kumar Sanjeev, Jain Amit International Journal of Scientific Research Vol-6|Issue-11|Feb 2018
  • Rapid spontaneous resolution of acute subdural hematoma: Case series and review of literature. (Asian journal of neurosurgery, Feb 2021)
  • Covid-19 pandemic lockdown- A cloud with silver lining for the road traffic accidents pandemic. (Neurology India 2021)
  • Management challenges and outcomes of traumatic brain injury due to bear maul in tribal areas of Chhattisgarh, India-Man verses wild. (journal of neurosciences in rural practice, June 2021)
  • Fourth ventricular epidermoid cyst : Case series, systematic review and analysis. (Asian journal of neurosurgery, Sep 2021)8.Lhermitte Duclos disease: what to expect during surgery?(Egyptian journal of neurosurgery, Dec 2021)
  • An expierence with Goel-Harms C1C2 fixation for Type 2 Odontoid fractures. (Journal of Craniovertebral junction and spine, 2022)
  • Hearing Rehabilitation after treatment of sporadic vestibular schwannoma. (Neurology India, 2022)
  • Extra-axial endoscopic third ventriculostomy: preliminary experience with a technique to circumvent conventional endoscopic third ventriculostomy complications. (Journal of neurosurgery, July 2022)
  • Postoperative herpes viral infections in neurosurgery- An experience and arguments for and against the plausible hypothesis. (Neurology India, 2022)
  • An Atypical Hangman’s Fracture with Atlantoaxial Instability managed by C1C2 Arthrodesis: A Case Illustration (Journal of Spinal Surgery 2023)
  • E Poster WFNS 2023 Atlanto-axial fixation for Type 2 Odontoid Fracture

CO-GUIDE

  • “A study of clinical manifestations and surgical outcome in cases of spinal dysraphism”,2020, Dr. B.R.A.M. Hospital, Raipur, C.G.
  • “Postoperative clinical and radiological assessment of Basilar Invagination” 2024-25, DKS Superspeciality hospital, Raipur, C.G.

name: Dr. B. Bala Krishna
description_html:
As a distinguished senior chest physician and leading pulmonologist in Chhattisgarh, I am committed to elevating respiratory healthcare through exceptional clinical expertise and innovative treatment strategies. With a robust background in diagnosing and managing complex pulmonary disorders, including asthma, COPD, and interstitial lung diseases, I employ a patient-centric approach that prioritizes individualized care and optimal outcomes. My dedication to continuous professional development ensures that I remain at the forefront of advancements in pulmonary medicine. By fostering interdisciplinary collaboration, I aim to enhance the standard of care, promote public awareness, and drive initiatives that significantly improve respiratory health across Central India.

Education and Training

  • MBBS, Chhattisgarh Institute Of Medical Sciences Bilaspur C.G,
  • DNB Pulmonary Medicine, JLN Hospital And Research Centre Bhilai C.G,
  • Interventional Pulmonology, Apollo Jubilee Hills Hyderabad,

Fellowships

  • Apollo Jubilee Hills
  • Apollo Chennai
  • Fellowship in sleep medicine -Delhi
  • Fellowship in Allergy- Patel hospital Delhi
  • Fellowship in PEADIATRIC airway disorder – Rainbow Hyderabad

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

  • Best free paper award in IMA Chhattisgarh 2015 state 2nd rank
  • Best poster presentation NAPCON 2017
  • Question Answer round winner NAPCON 2017
  • Received Bharat Seva Ratan Gold Medal July 2016 (GEPRA INDIA)
  • Awarded from Dr. Ajit Doval Ji(NSA CHIEF,INDIA) 2022

Area(S) Of Interest

    • Edno-bronchial disease (Airway pathology), lung carcinoma, pleural disease.
    • Lung cancer :-

As per recent study in our country (India) most common lung cancer is still squamous cell carcinoma but since few years in central India like Chhattisgarh ,Madhya Pradesh and some part of Orissa incidences of Adenocarcinoma also raising . Places like Bhilai, Korba, Raigarh and Pakahnjur etc. where people are exposed to heavy metal inhalation also suffering from mesothelioma and very high incidence of airway disease and lung malignancy.

Services Offered

  • ASTHMA
  • COPD
  • INTERSTITIAL LUNG DISEASE
  • ALLERGY
  • LUNG CANCER
  • AIRWAY DISORDER
  • SLEEP DISORDER
  • PLEURAL DISEASE

Professional Membership

  • Life Member of Indian Chest Society
  • Life Member of Indian Bronchology Society
  • Life Member of IMA
  • Life Member of Chhattisgarh Chest Society

RESEARCH PAPER

  • Methedology of season waves of respiratory disorder survey conducted at respiratory outpatient clinic acress India. Lung India 2020.
  • Yield of induced sputum in simple tubercular pleural effusion with no radiological lesion in lung parenchyma. Lung India.

WORKSHOPS PARTICIPATED

  • Bronchoscopy and Thoracoscopy in NAPCON 2013 at Chennai.
  • Sleep study (Polysomnography) in NAPCON 2013 at Chennai.
  • Bronchoscopy and Thoracoscopy in BRONCOCON 2014 at New Delhi.
  • Interventional Pulmonary Medicine workshop at Nagpur , april2014.
  • Interventional pulmonolgy workshop at Hinduja hospital Mumbai, oct 2015
  • ASPIRE interventional pulmonology conference and workshop at Hyderabad Apollo hospital Jubilee hills Feb 2016.
  • As Faculty for Mechanical Ventilator workshop NAPCON 2017.
  • As Faculty for newer medication for Asthma NAPCON 2018.
  • Conducted first post graduation workshop in Chhattisgarh 2019.
  • As a faculty Yashoda Hospital IP MENTOR 2023
  • As a faculty Yashoda Hospital CHEST IMAGING 2023
  • As a faculty Yashoda Hospital lung transplant symposium2023.
  • As a Faculty lung cancer symposium, Mumbai 2023.
  • As a faculty IP MENTOR, Hyderabad 2024.
  • As a faculty RESPICON, DELHI 2024.

CONFERENCES

  • 1st International Infectious Disease conference in INDIA 2012 at Hyderabad.
  • 1st International COPD conference in INDIA 2014,Pune.
  • National pulmonary diseases conferences NAPCON 2013, Chennai.
  • National Broncoscopy Conference BRONCOCON 2014 at New Delhi
  • AIIMS UPDATE 2016 (Delhi)
  • AIIMS UPDATE 2017 (Delhi)
  • AIIMS UPDATE 2018 (Delhi)
  • AIIMS UPDATE 2019 (Delhi)
  • AIIMS UPDATE 2022 (Delhi)
  • AIIMS UPDATE 2023 (Delhi)
  • AIIMS UPDATE 2024 (Delhi)

description_html:
I am Bhuwan Sharma, a neurologist the brain and spine specialist — based in the state capital Raipur, Chhattisgarh. I have been working in this field for the past 8 years, with the last 5 years serving as the Chief Neurologist. I have completed my MD medicine PGIMS Rohtak and DM neurology ABBMIS. For me perfect day is the day when I could bring smile to my patient and their loved ones.

Education and Training

  • MBBS, CIMS Chhattisgarh, 2011
  • MD Medicine, PGIMS Rohtak, 2016
  • DM Neurology, ABVIMS New Delhi, 2020

Area(S) Of Interest

  • Managing epilepsy patients (Special type of Epilepsy-JME)
  • Stroke
  • Pain Management
  • Critical care Neurology
  • Headache
  • Movement Disorder

Acheivements

  • Best paper presentation at econ 2019, Ahmedabad on effect of cognitive task on patients with JME.

  • Completed MD thesis work in field of Stroke.
  • Completed thesis work in DM in field of epilepsy.

Experience

  • Completed 3 years training program in medicine at PGIMS Rohtak as a junior resident.

  • IMA (Indian Medical Association)
  • API ( Association of Physician of India)
  • ISA (Indian Stroke Association)
  • IAN (Indian Academy of Neurology)
  • IES (Indian Epilepsy Society)

name: Dr. Hanish Sharma
description_html:
Dr Hanish Sharma is an astute clinician – Gastroenterologist , with special interest in Hepatology, Pancreatic diseases and Inflammatory bowel diseases, researcher trained in basic and clinical research ,skilled endoscopist and endosonologist and a keen enthusiast in new device biodesign.
After a meritorious schooling career at Bhilai, he obtained his MBBS from Pt Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur with honours in Physiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, Otorhinolaryngology and the university Gold Medal in Sugery in 2005. During his internship he topped the PG entrance examination and did his MD in Internal Medicine from All India Insitute of Medical Sciences, Delhi (2008). His graduate research work was recognized and awarded. Subsequently qualified for the DM programme in Gastroenterology at AIIMS, Delhi (2009-2012). He trained, worked and researched on emergent diseases especially acute liver failure, acute pancreatitis, celiac disease and primary liver cancer.
After the degree, he continued as a Senior Research associate at AIIMS Delhi till 2013. Under the mentorship of legendary teachers he participated in the development of consensus guidelines for primary liver cancer (HCC) and Asia-Pacific status repot on Celiac disease. During this time he was keenly involved with the Stanford India Biodesign programme which resulted in design and development of a safer liver biopsy device and prototypes for GI bleeding and paracentesis which have received international patents. He also participated in initial testing and trials of rectal continence device which got FDA approval. His work was awarded at national and international conferences. He has contributed to 15 indexed publications, apart from book chapters.
He is currently focused on providing one step services for gastroenterology at Chhattisgarh and form a nucleus for comprehensive advanced care in this region.

Education and Training

  • MBBS, Pt. JNM Medical College Raipur, 2005
  • MD Internal Medicine, AIIMS Delhi, 2008
  • DM Gastroenterology, AIIMS Delhi,2012

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

  • BioScoop liver biopsy project: (Team member) Judged 1st at the Empressario Indian Institute of Technology- Kharagpur Business plan competition 2013
  • Hepatology 360 Award Athens, Greece 2013
  • E Merck Award for Best Plenary Paper at APICON 2009
  • Certificates of Merit in physiology, pharmacology, pathology, ENT, ophthalmology and surgery
  • University Gold Medal in Surgery(MBBS)

Area(S) Of Interest

  • Liver Failure
  • ERCP
  • Pancreatitis
  • Inflammatory Bowel Disease(IBD)
  • Basic & Therapeutic Endoscopy

Services Offered

  • ERCP
  • Bile Duct Stenting
  • Pancreatic Endotherapy
  • G.I Bleed Management
  • Pseudocyst Drainage
  • Stricture Dilation
  • Capsule Endoscopy
  • PEG Placement

Professional Highlights

  • Fluent in therapeutic endoscopy, ERCP and Endoscopic ultrasound with hands on appreciation of their roles and risks.
  • Metallic Stent placement for Cancer Esophagus and bile duct,pancreas.
  • GI Bleed: Esophageal variceal ligation, clipping, managing ulcer bleeds.
  • Therapeutic endoscopic procedures Cystogastrostomy, necrosectomy, PEG tube placement, Achalasia cardia, Colonic polypectomy.
  • ERCP for bile duct diseases, Pancreatic leaks, Obstructive jaundice,cholangitis.
  • Endoscopic ultrasound guided procedures Fine needle aspiration cytology and biopsy.
  • Bariatric gastric balloon placements

Membership

  • ISG(Indian Society of Gastroendology)

Professional Membership

  • INASL(Indian National Association of Study of Liver Disease

name: Dr. Rakesh Singh
description_html:
After completing my MBBS , MD (PEDIATRICS),CFIN (NEONATOLOGY), I worked as pediatric intensivist in colors children hospital nagpur. I am exclusively trained in neonatology at some prestigious neonatal centres of country.Then joined Cloudnine hospital,Pune as Senior registrar in Neonatology.I worked as consultant neonatologist and Pediatrician at Ramkrishna care hospital since last 8 years. I have published some interesting papers in indexed journals.I am au I was faculty for point of care ultrasound at basic Pocus workshop. I am trainer of trainer of IAP NRP FGM for Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh state.

Education and Training

  • MBBS, Govt. Medical College Nagpur
  • MD Pediatrics, Indira Gandhi Govt. Medical College Nagpur,

Fellowships

  • Clinical Fellowship In Neonatology, MOSC Medical College, KOCHI,2015 Clinical Fellowship In Neonatology,BVDU, PUNE

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

  • Faculty for point of care ultrasound in Basic POCUS workshop held at Ramkrishna care in August 2024.
  • CERTIFICATE COURSE IN BASIC NEONATAL FUNCTIONAL ECHOCARDIOGRAPHY.
  • IAP NRP FGM TRAINER OF TRAINER for Maharashtra state and Chhattisgarh state.
  • Passed HELPING BABIES BREATHE certificate course held at Indira Gandhi medical college, Nagpur according to WHO, UNICEF guidelines.
  • WINNER OF IAP POST-GRADUATE QUIZ IN AUGUST 2012 held at IGGMC Nagpur.
  • RUNNER UP OF BREAST FEEDING QUIZ IN AUGUST 2012 held at IGGMC Nagpur.
  • PEDIATRICS ADVANCED LIFE SUPPORT (PALS): PASSED PALS CERTIFICATE COURSE HELD AT SEWAGRAM IN AUGUST 2011 which was according to the guidelines of American Academy of Pediatrics.

Area(S) Of Interest

My areas of interest are neonatal intensive care, preterm care including ELBW and VLBW, Nicu services, Point of care ultrasound , General pediatrics,pediatric allergy,etc

Services Offered

OPD for newborn and children, well baby clinic, Complete childhood vaccinations, Nicu and Picu services, General and private ward for children , Lactation counselling, Antenatal counselling, Newborn resuscitation during deliveries etc

Experience

Residency in Pediatric’s and neonatology from 2010- 2013
Pediatric and Neonatal intensivist, Colors children hospital, Nagpur (2013-2014)
SENIOR REGISTRAR in NEONATOLOGY AND PEDIATRICS, CLOUDNINE HOSPITAL, PUNE. (2015-2016)
CONSULTANT NEONATOLOGIST AND PEDIATRICIAN, SHRI BALAJI MULTISPECIALITY HOSPITAL AND RESEARCH CENTRE, RAIPUR (2016-2017)
VISITING CONSULTANT NEONATOLOGIST- SWAPNIL INSTITUTE OF CHILD HEALTH, RAIPUR
Ex Assistant professor in paediatrics at RIMS Raipur from 01/02/2019 to 01/07/2020
PRESENT APPOINTMENT- WORKING AS CONSULTANT PEDIATRICIAN AND NEONATOLOGIST AT Ramkrishna care hospital, RAIPUR SINCE SEPTEMBER 2017 TILL DATE

Professional Membership

  • LIFE MEMBER OF NATIONAL NEONATOLOGY FORUM
  • LIFE MEMBER OF INDIAN ACADEMY OF PEDIATRICS
  • LIFE MEMBER OF INDIAN MEDICAL ASSOCIATION,RAIPUR BRANCH

name: Dr. Vikash Kumar Dwivedi
description_html:
To achieve the challenging position in the field & to create an era of revolution in this field when I would be working in this sector of health care.

Education and Training

  • Bachelor of Physiotherapy (B.P.T.), C.G. Institute of Medical Sciences, Raipur (C.G.),2019
  • Master of Physiotherapy (M.P.T. Orthopaedic), Jaipur Physiotherapy College (Rajasthan), 2022
  • Doctor of Philosophy in Physiotherapy(PhD), Jaipur Physiotherapy College (Rajasthan),*pursuing
  • Bachelor of Social Work(B.S.W.),Study Centre(1510), Pt. Ravi Shankar Shukla University, Raipur (C.G).,2016
  • Post Graduate Diploma in Rural Development (P.G.D.R. D.),Study Centre(1510), Pt. Ravi Shankar ShuklaUniversity, Raipur (C.G.), 2019
  • Basic Course in Biomedical Research, 2021

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

  • President Chhattisgarh State Board at Global Association for Physiotherapy(GAPT)
  • EC Member the Indian Association of Physiotherapy CG State body.

Services Offered

  • Physiotherapy

Experience

  • Senior Consultant Physiotherapist (Head of Department) From 07.10.2022 to Till Department of Physiotherapy, Urmila Memorial Hospital, Raipur (C.G.)
  • Chief Consultant Physiotherapist (Head of Department) From 14-02-2024 to Till Shri Ramchandra Swami Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Center, Puranibasti, Raipur,(C.G.)
  • Visiting Consultant Physiotherapist From 01.07.2022 to Till Department of Physiotherapy, Horizon Hospital, Raipur (C.G.)
  • Consultant Physiotherapist From 03.03.2020 to 30.09.2021 Department of Physiotherapy, Shri Anant Sai Hospital, Raipur (C.G.)

Membership

  • MIAP

Professional Membership

  • EC Member the Indian Association of Physiotherapy CG State body

List of Publications

Dr. Vikash Kumar Dwivedi, Dr. Rajesh Kumar Sahu, Dr. L.S. Gajpal. (2020). A Study on the Effectiveness of A Community Based Observation of Directly Observed Treatment (DOT).
Universe International Journal of Interdisciplinary Research, 1(3), 94-104. https://doi- ds.org/doilink/08.2020- 69366773/

Conference & Workshop

  1. Participated as delegate in Hands on Workshop on Kinesiology Taping Technique Organized by Shri Duttatreya Charitable Physiotherapy Centre, Raipur (C.G.).
  2. Participated as delegate in Workshop on Basic Radio-Diagnosis & Role of Manual Mobilization Therapy in Arthritic Patients Organized by Sai Kripa Physiotherapy Centre, Raipur (C.G.).
  3. Participated as delegate in Apollo Excellence, Continuing Medical Education (CME) on “Emerging Trends in Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation” on 17th December 2017. Organized by Apollo Hospitals, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh and Accredited by National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (NABH).
  4. Participated as delegate in 3rd National Annual Conference on “Dialysis Technology and Organ Transplantation Organization” on 29th – 30th September 2018. Organized by DKS Post Graduate Institute & Research Centre, Raipur, Chhattisgarh & Chhattisgarh Human Transplantation Organization in association with Indian Association of Dialysis Technologists.
  5. Participated as delegate in Joint ISIC, IIT Delhi, Hamburg University of Technology & University of Toledo 3rd International Conference on “Clinical Spine & Orthopedic Biomechanics” on April 26th – 28th 2019. Organized by Indian Spinal Cord Injuries Centre, New Delhi.
  6. Participated as delegate in “Hands on Workshop on Bobath Approach Neuro Development Therapy (NDT) in Stroke Rehabilitation” on July 27th – 28th, 2019. Organized by Suyash Hospital, Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India. (Resource Person: Dr. Prabhat Ranjan, Senior Physiotherapist, AIIMS, New Delhi, India)
  7. Participated as delegate in “Hands on International Workshop on Band, Balls and Balance” on November 02nd – 03rd, 2019. Organized by Suyash Hospital, Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India. (Resource Person: Dr. Mahendra K. Yadav, Chief Physiotherapist, Quality Care Medical Center, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates)
  8. Participated as delegate in “1st Youth Physio-Webicon 2020” International E-Conference of Physiotherapists and Students on 26th April 2020 to 30th April 2020. Organized by Students Wing of Haryana Chartered Association of Physiotherapists (Regd.) in collaboration with Jagannath University, Bahadurgarh, Haryana, India. Theme: Transforming Education in COVID-19 Lockdown through E-learning.
  9. Participated as delegate in “Five Days International Web-Workshop on Impact of COVID-19 on Society & Culture” from April 29th, 2020 to May 3rd, 2020. Organized by Dept. of Sociology, DAV PG College Varanasi, U.P., India.
  10. Participated as delegate in “International Webicon – 2020 on Transforming Medical Education in COVID-19 Lockdown 3.0 through E-learning” from May 15th, 2020 to May 17th, 2020. Organized by Shri Anant Sai Hospital, Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India.
  11. Participated in “Hands on Workshop on Dry Needling with CPD (UK) approved Certificate Course in Dry Needling” from June 29th – July 02nd, 2023. Organized by The Physilife Academy in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India. (Resource Person: Dr. Subhanjan Das, Chief Physiotherapist, Physilife, Bangalore, India)
  12. Participated in “Hands on Workshop on Stretch and Strengthen your Body & Mind with Thera-band Certificate Course in Hands on International Workshop on Advanced Thera-band, Balls & Balance” from October 01st – 02nd, 2023. Organized by The Thera-band Academy in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India. (Resource Person: Dr. Mahendra K. Yadav, Abu Dhabi, UAE)
  13. Participated in 1st State Conference of Physiotherapy CG PHYSIOCON 2023 as a member of the scientific committee.
  14. Participated in “Hands on Workshop on Certified Cupping Therapy with CPD (UK) approved Certificate Course in Cupping Therapy” on February 1st, 2024. Organized by The Physilife Academy in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India. (Resource Person: Dr. Subhanjan Das, Chief Physiotherapist, Physilife, Bangalore, India)
  15. Participated in “Hands on Workshop on Integrated Therapeutic Taping with CPD (UK) approved Certificate Course in Integrated Therapeutic Taping” from February 2nd – 04th, 2024. Organized by The Physilife Academy in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India. (Resource Person: Dr. Subhanjan Das, Chief Physiotherapist, Physilife, Bangalore, India)

name: Dr. Vivek Mahawar
qualification: MBBS, DMRD, DNB (Radio Diagnosis), DMRE, Fellowship (Interventional Radiology), Fellowship (Diagnostic Radiology)
specialization: MBBS, DMRD, DNB (Radio Diagnosis), DMRE, Fellowship (Interventional Radiology), Fellowship (Diagnostic Radiology)
description_html:
Education and Training

  • MBBS, Pt. JNM Medical College Raipur C.G, 1998
  • DNB Radiodiagnosis, National Board of Examinations New delhi, 2005
  • DMRD, Lokmanya Tilak Municipal Medical College Mumbai, 2003
  • DMRE, College of Physicians & Surgeons Of Bombay, 2004

Fellowships

  • Fellowship in Dept. Of Interventional Radiology, Tata Memorial Hospital Mumbai, 2019
  • Fellowship in Dept. Of Diagnostic Radiology, MD Anderson Cancer Center, Texas, US, 2019

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

  • Contributed a chapter(Imaging in Oral Cavity Carcinoma) as author.
  • Participated in organisation of SOIICON 2019
  • Part of organizing committee XIIIth interventional radiology group meet in july 2016
  • Participation in Formative assessment 2015,2017, and 2019 as examiner DNB Radiodiagnosis.

Area(S) Of Interest

  • Head & Neck Radiology
  • Neuroradiology
  • Musculoskeletal Radiology

RESEARCH PROJECT

  • Guide in DNB thesis: “Radiopathological correlation of tumor regression in rectal carcinoma”.
  • Guide in DNB thesis: “Role of DWI in different neoplasm in skeletal musculature”.
  • Guide in DNB thesis: “Role of ADC values in assessing response to chemo radiotherapy in Cervix Cancer and identifying residual disease”.
  • Co-guide in DNB thesis:“Importance of DWI in detecting prostate cancer”.
  • Co-guide in DNB thesis “Role of diffusion weighted MRI imaging in differentiation of residual or recurrent head and neck malignancies and post treatment changes in comparison with histopathology /cytology findings.
  • RARE CASE OF SYNOVIAL CHONDROMATOSIS PRESENTING AS JAW PAIN international Journal of Current Research Vol. 10, Issue, 03, pp.66433-66435, March, 2018, Dr. Vivek Mahawar, Dr. Ankush Jajodia and Dr. Venkata Pradeep Babu Koyyala, 2018
  • Case report: Rare case of an isolated myeloid sarcoma presenting as dysphagia. Asian J Oncol 2018;4:30-3. Rishu Sangal, Vivek Mahawar1, Ankush Jajodia1.
  • Case report: Role of Diagnostic Block in S1 radiculopathy in a patient of carcinoma rectum with leg pain published in JORAPAIN- International Journal on RecentAdvances in Pain in January-April 2018;4(1):44-46. Mahawar B, Mahawar V, Sahi M
  • Case report: Methotrexate induced neurotoxicity: A stroke mimic, International Journal of Medical and Health Research, ISSN: 2454-9142. Impact Factor: RJIF 5.54. www.medicalsciencejournal.com. Volume 4; Issue 4; April 2018; Page No. 32-34. Dr. Wasif Bashir, Dr. Ankush Jajodia, Dr. Rishab Agarwal, Dr. K Venkata Pradeep Babu*, Dr. Vivek Mahawar,
  • Case Report: Recurrent carcinoma rectum patient presented with S 1 radiculopathy- An Unusual Presentation- Case report published in International Journal Of Science And Research Methodology (IJSRM) in April 2018 Vol:9, Issue:2 Bablesh Mahawar1, Vivek Mahawar2 , Ankush Jajodia3.
  • Is chest X-ray an adequate modality for confirming position of central venous catheter in patients with malignant pleural effusion : published in international journal of scientific research Volume-7/Issue-9/September2018/ISSN No. 2277-8179/IF4.758/IC value :93.98. name: Dr. Ekta Jain
description_html:
Dr Ekta Batavia Jain is a skill surgeon and clinician with her speciality in Ophthalmic Surgeries. She has special interest in Retinal Surgeries, ROP, Uvea, Cataract, Glaucoma, Neuro-ophthalmology.
After finishing her schooling from Raipur, she did her MBBS from Wardha (M.H.) following which she did her DNB Ophthalmology from Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Having finished her specialization she worked in AIIMS Raipur for more than a year, where she was actively involved in patient care managing complicated cases including ocular trauma and also as a teaching faculty for MBBS and Post Graduate students.
She then pursued Fellowship in Vitreo-Retina Surgeries from esteemed Shankar Nethralaya, Chennai, where she got exposed to difficult retinal surgeries including ocular tumors and a special training on screening and treating ROP. She had been involved in many paper and poster presentations and won few of them. Was winner in various quiz competitions as well held in regional conferences.

Education and Training

  • Senior Residency in All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS, Raipur) 2017-2019.
  • Post Graduate DIPLOMATE OF NATIONAL BOARD in Ophthalmology 2014-2017, from Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute, Coimbatore (T.N.) (1st attempt).
  • MBBS from Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, DMIMSU, Wardha (M.H.), 2007 batch.

Fellowships

  • Fellowship in Vitreo-retinal services 2019-2020 from Shankar Nethralaya (Kolkata/Chennai).
  • Fellowship in International Council of Ophthalmology

Awards, Honours & Recognitions

  • Participated in various ophthalmology conferences and CME
  • Stood first in poster presentation in Retina Debate 2.0
  • Stood second in Just a Minute session at TNOA, 2016
  • Was a finalist in post graduate quiz in TNOA, 2016
  • Participated in cultural programmes in undergraduate and postgraduate college annual day functions.
  • Represented school in inter-school dance, singing and debate competitions. Visharad in classical music (vocal) from Shri Ram Sangeet Mahavidyalaya, Raipur

Area(S) Of Interest

  • Retina
  • ROP
  • Cataract
  • Glaucoma
  • Uvea
  • Neuro-ophthalmology

Professional Highlights

  • Assistant Professor SRIMSR, Raipur
  • Senior Resident, AIIMS, Raipur

Professional Membership

  • DELHI OPHTHALMIC SOCIETY
  • ALL INDIA OPHTHALMIC SOCIETY
  • CHHATTISGARH SOCIETY OF OPHTHALMIC SURGEONS
  • TAMIL NADU OPHTHALMIC SOCIETY

My Research and Publications

Sl. No Publications Journal / Publisher Year of Publication
1. Relationship of Anthropometric Indices to Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. Indian Council of Medical Research – Short Term Studentship Program 2010
2. Medroxyprogesterone acetate to treat corneal thinning post curvularia keratitis – a case report Oman Journal of Ophthalmology September 2019
3. Co-existence of retinal angiomatous proliferation and pachychoroid phenotype. Indian Journal of Ophthalmology October 2020
S. No. Title Platform Mode
1 Relationship of Anthropometric Indices to Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. APPICON – 2010 Paper presentation
2 Intravitreal Anti-VEGF for diabetic macular edema with prompt versus deferred laser photocoagulation TNOA – 2015 Paper presentation
3 Persistent Unilateral Disc Edema with Optic Nerve Cysticercosis TNOA – 2016 E-Poster
4 Allergic eye disease – An overview Cornea Meet – CSOS, 2017 Paper presentation
5 Global Choroidal Thickness profile in acute and chronic CSR Retina Debate 2.0, 2019 Physical poster

  • Stroke
  • Epilepsy
  • Botox for Neurological disorders

name: Dr. Dhiraj Premchandani
description_html:
Dr Dhiraj Premchandani is a highly trained gastrointestinal and laparoscopic surgeon with extensive education and experience. He completed his FNB in Minimal Access Surgery from P.D. Hinduja Hospital, Mumbai (2017–2019), and earned his M.S. in General Surgery from Dr. D.Y. Patil University, Navi Mumbai (2011–2014). He holds an M.B.B.S. from Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru Memorial Medical College, Raipur (2004–2011), and pursued clinical electives in surgery at Weill Cornell Medical College, New York.He holds work experience from around the country like- GB Pant Hospital New Delhi, Sir JJ Hospital and Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai. Dr Dhiraj Premchandani specializes in advanced laparoscopic procedures and gastrointestinal diseases, offering patient-centred minimally invasive care. He is an active member of several prestigious medical associations, including: Association of Surgeons of India (ASI), Indian Association of GI and Endoscopic Surgeons (IAGES), Association of Colon and Rectal Surgeons of India (ACRSI)

Education and Training

  • FNB (Minimal Access Surgery)– PD Hinduja Hospital Mahim, Mumbai
  • MS (General Surgery) – Padmashree Dr D.Y. Patil University, Navi Mumbai
  • MBBS – Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru Memorial Medical College. Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur

Fellowships

  • FMAS, DMAS- World Laparoscopy Hospital Gurugram 2017
  • FIAGES 2018
  • FALS Colorectal 2021
  • FACRSI 2021

Services Offered

  • Minimal Access Surgery
  • Laparoscopy surgery
  • Hernia Surgery with Abdominal wall reconstruction
  • Alcoholic Liver Disease
  • GERD
  • Colorectal Cancer
  • Gastro-intestinal Oncology
  • Proctology- Piles, Fissure and Fistula

Professional Highlights

  • Former Consultant – Surgical Gastroenterologist, Dept. of HPB & Liver Transplant, Ramkrishna Care Hospital, Raipur
  • Fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery (FNB), P.D. Hinduja Hospital, Mumbai
  • Former Associate Consultant, Hinduja Hospital, Mumbai
  • Assistant Professor, General & Minimal Access Surgery, Grant Medical College and Sir JJ Group of Hospitals, Mumbai
  • Advanced training via observer-ship at Tata Memorial Hospital (GI & Colorectal Surgery)
  • Extensive laparoscopic and robotic surgery experience, including pancreatic, colorectal and hernia surgeries
  • International Clinical Elective at Weill Cornell Medical College, New York

Professional Specialties

  • Gastrointestinal Surgery
  • Hepato-pancreato-biliary (HPB) Surgery
  • Laparoscopic and Minimal Access Surgery
  • Colorectal Surgery
  • Robotic GI Surgery
  • Abdominal Wall Reconstruction
  • Complex Hernia Repairs

Professional Membership

  • Association of Surgeons of India (ASI)
  • Indian Association of Gastrointestinal and Endoscopic Surgeons (IAGES)
  • Association of Colon and Rectal Surgeons of India (ACRSI)
  • AWR Surgeons (Abdominal Wall Reconstruction Society)

Research Work

Publications

Dr. Premchandani has contributed to several peer-reviewed surgical journals:

  • Laparoscopic repair of a combined transmesocolic, transomental hernia – J Minim Access Surg, 2019
  • Laparoscopic stapled plication of left hemi-diaphragmatic eventration – Asian J Endosc Surg, 2019
  • Thoracoscopic management of intrathoracic migrated gallstone – Indian J Thorac Cardiovasc Surg, 2019
  • Laparoscopic excision of a psoas muscle schwannoma – J Minim Access Surg, 2021

National Presentations

E-Posters and Surgical Videos presented at SELSICON, MASICON, IAGES, HSICON, IHPBA, and ACRSICON

Topics include:

    • Laparoscopic diaphragmatic hernia repair
    • Thoracoscopic lung cyst excision
    • TAPE hernia repair
    • Robotic distal pancreatectomy
    • Mucinous adenocarcinoma in fistula-in-ano
    • Rare hernia repairs and tumor excisions

name: Dr. Rakesh Kumar Mishra
description_html:
With over 10 years of experience in both government and private sectors, I have dedicated my career to providing comprehensive cancer care to patients. My expertise spans the diagnosis, treatment, and management of various types of cancers, including solid tumors and hematological malignancies. As a medical oncologist, I am committed to providing compassionate and comprehensive care to my patients. I believe that cancer care is not just about treating the disease, but also about supporting the patient and their family throughout the journey. I am passionate about raising cancer awareness and promoting prevention strategies to reduce the burden of cancer in our community.

Education and Training

  • MBBS
  • Pt J N M Medical College, Raipur, (C.G.)
  • MD Radiotherapy (Gold medalist)
  • King George Medical University, Lucknow (U.P.)
  • D M Medical Oncology
  • Dr B Borooah Cancer Institute, Guwahati, Assam

Fellowships

Bone marrow transplant training at TMH Mumbai.

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

University Gold medal in MD Radiotherapy exam.

Area(S) Of Interest

cancer awareness,cancer prevention and cancer vaccination.

Services Offered

Chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy and personalised cancer care, cancer genetics.

Experience

  • Professional Highlights. Worked as consultant at Balco medical center and Sanjeevani cancer hospital Raipur
  • Membership: JCI
  • Professional Specialties:
  • Professional Membership: AROI, CG oncology association, ESMO, ASCO

Research Work

7 research publications in various journals and participated in clinical trial.

name: Dr. Abhijit Sahu
description_html:
Dr.Abhijit is a dedicated Trauma and Orthopaedic Surgeon with over 10 years of clinical experience in managing complex musculoskeletal injuries and disorders. Skilled in both elective and emergency orthopaedic procedures,he is committed to restoring mobility and improving patients quality of life. With a strong focus on evidence-based practice, surgical precision, and compassionate patient care, he has built a reputation for excellence in trauma management, joint reconstruction, and fracture care. Beyond the operating theatre, he actively contributes to research, education, and mentoring the next generation of orthopaedic professionals.

Education and Training:

  • Aug 2016 – Sep 2017 Fellowship in Joint Replacement Surgery(MUHS)
  • Bombay Hospital,Mumbai, India
  • June 2019 – August 2019 Travelling Fellow
  • Asia Pacific Arthroplasty Society (Australia , Indonesia , Malaysia , Pune, Chennai , Mumbai)
  • Jan 2024 – Jan 2024 Travelling Fellowship
  • British India Orthopaedic Society

Area(S) Of Interest:

  • Fractures, Trauma
  • Joint Replacement
  • Arthroscopy
  • Injections
  • Key hole surgery

Experience:

  • General Medical Council, United Kingdom
  • Maharashtra Medical Council, India
  • Chhattisgarh Medical Council,India
  • Life Member Asia Pacific Arthroplasty Society(APAS)
  • Life Member of Indian Medical Association(IMA)
  • Life Member of Society of Knee Surgeons of India(SKI)
  • Left Member British India Orthopaedic Society

Research Work:

Audit

1. Foot School Audit – St. Helens & Knowsley Teaching Hospitals (March 2020)

Aim: To assess if the foot school is instrumental in facilitating early discharge.

Results: Helps quick patient discharge and reduces burden on physiotherapists to teach protocol within a short time. Also helps the trust as patients attending the foot school clinic come only as day cases.

Recommendations: Elective listing forms should include a tick box for foot school so the TCI team can invite listed patients. Consultants and registrars should encourage patients to attend foot school.

2. Evaluation of New Patients Booked into the Fracture Clinic – St. Helens & Knowsley Teaching Hospitals (Nov 2021)

Aim: To assess the number of face-to-face new patients seen by the Orthopaedics Department and evaluate distribution and triaging for consultant clinics.

Results: Upper limb clinics have a higher number of follow-up appointments. The average number of new patients is unequally distributed, with notable overbooking in upper limb clinics.

Publications

  • Tuberculosis of the greater trochanter presenting as avulsion fracture of the greater tuberosity – Asian Pacific Journal of Tropical Diseases
  • An aggressive aneurysmal bone cyst in an adult – International Journal of Current Medical Sciences
  • Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma of calcaneum, inguinal and popliteal region – International Journal of Advanced Research
  • Ultrasound guided platelet rich plasma infiltration for chronic tendinopathy – Saudi Journal of Sports Medicine
  • Neglected post-traumatic fracture-dislocation of knee with supracondylar femur fracture managed with bridging plate and total knee arthroplasty – The Journal of Orthopaedics (Chhattisgarh chapter, IOA) ISSN 0975-7333 Vol.4 No.1, 2017

Posters

  • Role of MRI in diagnosing Shoulder Pathologies – BIOS 2023, Windsor, UK
  • A rare presentation of neuropathic arthropathy of elbow joint caused by Arnold Chiari malformation with syringomyelia – MAOCON 2012
  • Management of pathological fracture through simple bone cyst in proximal femur in pregnant woman – VOSCON 2012
  • A treatment approach for adhesive capsulitis – IASM 2017, Goa, India

Papers

  • Management of adult forearm fractures by stacking technique – NAILSCON 2013 (Nagpur, India)
  • Infection Control in Orthopaedics – VOSCON 2015 (Nagpur, India)
  • Proximal Humerus Fractures – Sion Fracture Course (Mumbai, India)
  • Adhesive Capsulitis: Arthroscopic releases – Does Subscapularis division help? – ACASEA 2017 (Mumbai, India)
  • Treatment of Charcot Joints using Total Knee Arthroplasty – APAS 2018 (Bangkok)
  • Functional outcome of Total Knee Arthroplasty in patients above 50 years using knee society score – APAS 2018 (Bangkok)
  • Total Hip Arthroplasty in Dysplastic Hips – APAS 2019 (Fujian, China)

description_html:

  1. Complex Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG) with off-pump and on-pump techniques
  2. Total Arterial Revascularisation.
  3. Valvular Heart Surgery.
  4. Congenital heart defect repair, such as atrial septal defect (ASD), ventricular septal defect (VSD), Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF), patent ductus arteriosus (PDA), and partial anomalous pulmonary venous connections (PAPVC).
  5. Minimal invasive Cardiac surgery (MICS).
  6. Redo Cardiac Surgery.
  7. Thoracic trauma.
  8. Vascular surgery including AV (arteriovenous) Fistula Creation , AV shunts, vascular repair, Aneurysmal surgeries, Varicose veins and other complex vascular issues.

name: Dr. Kunal Ostwal
description_html:
Expert interventional cardiologist with a belief in holistic and comprehensive cardiac care, including both preventive and curative approaches. With experience of over 2000 procedures, we aim to bring the best to our patients in terms of skill and strategy. Holding a keen interest in preventive cardiology, we aim to inculcate healthy lifestyle habits among people and educate them about cardiac hazards, as well as the ways to deal with them.

Education and Training:

  • ICMR RESEARCH AWARDEE

  • CORONARY IMAGING.
  • STRUCTURAL HEART DISEASE.
  • HEART FAILURE AND ITS DEVICES.

name: Dr. Mridul Tantia
qualification: MS, DrNB (Gastro Intestinal Surgery), FMAS (Minimal Access Surgery)
description_html:
Dr. Mridul Tantia is a Consultant GI & Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary (HPB) Surgeon at ILS Hospitals, specializing in advanced laparoscopic and robotic gastrointestinal surgery. His key interests include pancreaticobiliary and colorectal surgeries, with a focus on complex benign and malignant conditions. He has contributed to multiple peer-reviewed publications and has received awards at national and international conferences. Dr. Tantia practices evidence-based, multidisciplinary care with an emphasis on precision and patient-centered outcomes.

Work Experience:

  • Senior Resident, Department of General Surgery, IPGMER and SSKM hospital, Kolkata.
  • Senior Resident, Department of Minimal Access Surgery, ILS Hospitals, Kolkata.
  • DrNB, Resident Department of Surgical Gastroenterology,SIDSS- Santokba Durlabhji Memorial Hospital, Jaipur

Educational Qualification:

  • DrNB, Surgical Gastroenterology- Santokba Durlabhji Memorial Hospital, Jaipur.
  • Fellow Minimal Access Surgery (FMAS)
  • MS General Surgery (1st Attempt) MGM- Medical College & Hospital, Aurangabad
  • M.B.B.S (1st Attempt) -MS Ramaiah Medical College, Bangalore RGUHS

Membership:

  • AMASI
  • ASI

Awards & Recognitions:

  • Best E-Video presentation awarded for “Laparoscopic Living Donor Right Hepatectomy” in IHPBA India 2024, at Pondicherry.
  • Second Prize awarded for Paper presentation in Best State Chapter of ASI (ASICON 2020) on, “A Prospective Study of Same Sitting ERCP/ Stenting & Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy in Management of CBD Stones with Gall Stones”, Dec 2020
  • First Prize awarded for Best Paper in AMASICON 2020 on, “Glycemic Control in Patients Achieving Diabetes Remission with Weight Loss an RCT Comparing LSG Vs MGB-OAGB– Five Year Follow Up”,Nov 2020
  • First Prize awarded for Best Paper in Maharashtra Chapter of ASI (MASICON 2020) on, “A Prospective Study of Same Sitting ERCP/ Stenting & Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy in Management of CBD Stones with Gall Stones”,
    Jan 2020.
  • First Prize-Dr. C. Palanivelu Gold Medal for Best Video in AMASICON 2019 on, “Intramural Vascular Extension of Pheochromocytoma – A Rare Case”, Nov 2019.
  • First Prize awarded for poster presentation in MASICON 2019 on, “Schwannoma in Disguise”, Feb 2019.
  • Second Prize for Best Paper in MCIAPS 2018 on, “Esophageal lung”, Jul 2018.

Research Experience:

  • DrNB Surgical Gastroenterology- “Intra-operative fluoroscopic angiographic assessment of vascularity of
    bowel in patients with mesenteric ischaemia with gangrene and its impact on operative outcome: a
    prospective study”
  • MS General Surgery- “A Prospective Interventional Study of Same Setting ERCP/ Stenting & Laparoscopic
    Cholecystectomy in Management of CBD Stones with Gall Stones “

Publications:

  • Indian J Surg 85, 854–858 (2023)“Endoscopic Bile Duct Clearance Followed by Same-Day Cholecystectomy:
    a Case S
  • J Minim Access Surg. 2021;17(4):551-553.“Gastric glomus tumour: A case report”
  • J Neonatal Surg. 2019Dec.27;8(3):24.” Esophageal Bronchus: A Case Report”
  • Medpulse International Journal of Surgery. October 2019; 12(1): 15-17,
    https://www.medpulse.in/Surgery/” A large ovarian cyst with uterine torsion: A Case report”

name: Dr. Shilika Lalwani
qualification: MBBS, MD (Internal Medicine), DNB (Internal Medicine),PGDGM (Geriatric med), DrNB Endocrinology & Metabolism
description_html:
Dr. Shilika Lalwani Budhwani is a dedicated endocrinologist committed to empowering patients to understand and manage their hormonal health with confidence. She completed her advanced DrNB Endocrinology training from the prestigious Army Hospital (Research & Referral), New Delhi, following postgraduate training in Internal Medicine. Her clinical expertise spans diabetes, thyroid disorders, PCOS, obesity, metabolic diseases, and pediatric endocrinology, allowing her to care for patients across all age groups. Dr. Shilika believes that informed patients make better health decisions and focuses on combining evidence-based medicine with practical lifestyle guidance. Through compassionate care, education, and outreach, she strives to help individuals achieve lasting hormonal balance and healthier lives.

Education & Training

  • MBBS: IGGMC & Mayo Hospital, Nagpur
  • MD Internal Medicine: BJGMC & Sassoon Hospital, Pune
  • DrNB Endocrinology: Army Hospital Research & Referral, New Delhi

Fellowships

  • PGDGM (Geriatric Medicine) – IGNOU

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

  • University Gold Medalist (Medicine)

Areas of Interest

  • Diabetes
  • Thyroid
  • PCOS
  • Women’s Health
  • Obesity
  • Pediatric Endocrinology
  • Pituitary Disorders
  • Adrenal & Parathyroid Disorders

Services Offered

Comprehensive Care for Hormonal Health
Holistic endocrine care at every stage of life with modern diagnostics and personalized treatment.

Diabetes Care

Advanced diagnosis and personalized treatment for Type 1, Type 2, gestational diabetes, and prediabetes, focusing on long-term control and prevention of complications.

Thyroid Disorders

Expert management of hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, thyroid nodules, and goiter, with precise hormonal evaluation and tailored treatment plans.

PCOS & Women’s Hormonal Health

Specialized care for PCOS, irregular periods, hormonal acne, excess hair growth, and fertility-related endocrine issues.

Obesity & Metabolic Health

Medical weight management and treatment of obesity, insulin resistance, and metabolic syndrome using modern evidence-based therapies.

Pediatric Endocrinology

Evaluation and treatment of growth problems, early or delayed puberty, childhood obesity, and other hormonal disorders in children and adolescents.

Bone & Calcium Disorders

Diagnosis and management of osteoporosis, vitamin D deficiency, parathyroid disorders, and metabolic bone diseases.

Pituitary & Adrenal Disorders

Expert care for complex endocrine conditions such as Cushing’s syndrome, acromegaly, prolactinoma, and adrenal gland disorders.

Preventive Hormonal Health Screening

Early detection and risk assessment for diabetes, thyroid disorders, metabolic syndrome, and hormonal imbalances to maintain long-term health.

Professional Highlights

Memberships

  • Endocrine Society of India
  • Indian Thyroid Society
  • RSSDI (Approval Pending)

name: Dr. Abhishek Tripathi
description_html:
Dr. Abhishek Tripathi is a distinguished Orthopedic Surgeon renowned for his surgical precision and commitment to patient mobility. With a career defined by clinical excellence, Dr. Tripathi has successfully performed more than 2,000 joint replacement surgeries, establishing himself as a high-volume expert in the field.

Specializing in Joint Replacement and Sports Injury, he combines advanced surgical techniques with a patient-centric approach to restore function and enhance quality of life. His robust academic foundation includes an MBBS from Pt. JNMMC Raipur and an MS from SNMC Agra, he received many fellowships from various parts of the country like MUMBAI, BENGALURU, AHMEDABAD, DELHI, VAPI, providing him with the rigorous training necessary to manage complex orthopedic cases with exceptional skil

Education and Training

  • Pt.J.N.M.M.C.Raipur(MBBS)
  • S. N.Medical College, Agra)

Fellowships

  • cooper hospital mumbai
  • Knee and spine clinic mumbai
  • Basic and advance arthroscopy training from MS Ramaiah college bengaluru
  • Robotic joint replacement fellowship from Vapi, gujrat

Awards, Honors & Recognitions

  • 1st in all over chhattisgarh who did golden (opulent) knee replacement
  • 1st in chhattisgarh who did Meril’s DUAL MOBILITY Hip replacement

Area of intrust

  • Complex primary and revision TKR
  • 1st in chhattisgarh who did Meril’s DUAL MOBILITY Hip replacement
  • Very precise and minimal incision for knee and hip replacement
  • Total hip replacement by Direct Anterior Aproach
  • Management of ligament Tear and sports Injury by arthroscopy
  • Simple and complex trauma
  • Back pain and knee pain specialist
  • Rheumatoid disorder specialist

Experience

  • 1 November 2022 to 30 April – Working as consultant orthopedic surgeon and head of
    department at UMH, Raipur, Chhattisgarh
  • 13 November 2018 to 30 October 2022 worked as consultant orthopedic surgeon and head
    of department in FORTIS OP JINDAL hospital and research center

Professional Highlights

  • Membership
  • IOA mebership
  • CGIOA membership
  • EXECUTIVE BODY MEMBER OF CG ARTHROPLASTY ASSOCIATION

name: Dr. Soumita Sadhukhan
description_html:
Doctor Soumita has done a Rotatory internship at NRS Medical College & Hospital. She also gained experience in the Department of General Medicine and the specialties of Gastroenterology, Cardiology, Respiratory Medicine, Endocrinology, Rheumatology, and Neurology at Army Hospital.  Additionally, held the position of Senior Resident at Beliaghata ID Hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic.

RELEVANT PUBLICATIONS, PAPERS, AND PRESENTATIONS:

1. Analysis of Poisoning Cases in Pediatric Patients Admitted to a Tertiary Care Hospital September 2018, IOSR Journal of Dental and Medical Sciences, 17(8):34-43 DOI: 10.9790/0853-1708133443

2. Congenital Plasmodium Vivax Malaria Complicated by Maternal TORCH Infection: A Diagnostic Challenge October 2016, IOSR Journal of Dental and Medical Sciences, 15(10):67-69 DOI: 10.9790/0853-1510046769

3. Neurological Adverse Events Following COVID-19 Vaccination: An Observational Study from a Tertiary Care Center in Eastern India September 2023 DOI: 10.20944/preprints202309.1789.v1

4. Chronic Progressive Cerebellar Ataxia with an Unexpected Diagnosis Presented at the 8th Asian and Oceanian Parkinson’s Disease and Movement Disorder Congress, 2023.

5. A Case Report of Ornithine Transcarbamylase Deficiency with an Unusual Presentation Presented at ANEICON 2023.

6. A Study on Clinical, Laboratory, and Radiological Factors Predicting Responsiveness and Refractoriness to High-Dose Steroids in Initial Attacks and Acute Relapses of Primary Inflammatory Demyelinating Disorders of the Central Nervous System in Patients Admitted to a Tertiary Care Center. Dissertation paper in DM.

specialization: MBBS, MS (Surgery), FIAGES, FMAS,General, Laparoscopic & Gastrointestinal Surgery
description_html:
Dr Santanu Sarkar is a highly skilled and compassionate surgeon, with over 15 years of experience, specializing in General Surgery, Laparoscopic Surgery, Gastrointestinal Surgery, Surgical Oncology, and Diabetic Foot Care. His dedication to patient care and commitment to excellence have earned him a reputation as a trusted healthcare provider. After completing MS in General Surgery from Medical College & Hospital Kolkata, he undergone training in Surgical Oncology from Saroj Gupta Cancer Centre & Research Institute Kolkata and thereafter completed Fellowship of Indian Association of Gastrointestinal Endo surgeons & Fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery. Dr Sarkar combines his extensive experience with the latest advancements in surgical techniques to provide the highest level of care to his patients. name: Dr. Tamonas Chaudhuri
description_html: Dr Tamonas Chaudhuri graduated from B. S Medical College, Bankura Medical College, and was awarded a Master of Surgery by the University of Calcutta after successful training at the Institute of Post Graduate Medical Education and Research, Kolkata, India. He joined West Bengal Medical Education at the age of thirty at R G Kar Medical College, Kolkata. He was actively involved in Surgical Education and patient care. He conceptualized and developed Minimal Invasive Surgery Unit at R G Kar Medical College, Kolkata, and acted in In-charge for more than three years. He is one of the pioneers in the progression of Minimal Access Surgery in Government institutions in West Bengal. He has published fifteen articles in different national & international journals. His area of interest is Minimal Access Surgery and he got trained at GEM Hospital, Coimbatore, India, and Sir Gangaram Hospital, New Delhi where Prof. Palanivelu was his mentor. Now he is the Secretary of Minimal Access Surgeons of India, Governing Council Member of the Association of Surgeons of India. He was involved in national disaster management like Flood relief and Aila at Sunderban. Currently, he is associated as a Consultant Surgeon at ILS Hospitals, Kolkata. Besides, being a Professor of Surgery and a senior faculty in this field, he organizes training programs and courses for Surgical Skill Development. He is also the examiner of different universities in India and assessor of the Medical Council of India.

name: Dr. Ratnabali Chakravorty
description_html: Dr Ratnabali Chakravorty is a Gynecologist and Infertility Specialist and has an experience of 41 years in these fields. She completed MBBS from Medical College, Calcutta in 1983, MD – Obstetrics & Gynaecology from Medical College, Calcutta in 1989 and DGO from Medical College, Calcutta in 1986. She is a member of Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India (FOGSI),BOGS,ISOPARB,Founder secretarty of India menopause society kolkata chapter, PCOS, Indian Fertility Society and Consensus group. Some of the services provided by the doctor are: Vaccination/ Immunization, Vagina Surgery,Gynae Problems, Unilateral Salpingo-Oophorectomy and Diseases in Pregnancy etc.

name: Dr. Siddharth Gupta
qualification: MBBS, MS (Ortho), Fellowship in Advanced Arthroscopy & Arthroplasty
specialization: MBBS, MS (Ortho), Fellowship in Advanced Arthroscopy & Arthroplasty
description_html: Dr. Siddharth Gupta completed his medical education at the prestigious IPGME&R SSKM Hospital in Kolkata, followed by his postgraduate studies at Government Medical College Nagpur. He has gained valuable experience working in the emergency services department at SSKM Hospital for one year. His clinical expertise encompasses a comprehensive range of orthopedic care, including advanced trauma management, joint replacement, sports injuries, spinal surgeries, infections of bones and joints, correction of deformities, and rehabilitation. Notably, he served as a consultant for the Kolkata Knight Riders during the Indian Premier League (IPL). Dr. Gupta has conducted clinical research on various topics, including fractures, wrist bones, humerus, proximal femur, calcaneus, spine, knee arthritis, pediatric hip arthritis, and spinal deformities, among others. He has presented numerous research papers at both national and international conferences and has several publications in esteemed international journals. Additionally, he is proficient in robotic and minimally invasive surgical techniques, ensuring that he delivers tailored treatment plans that meet the specific needs of his patients while maintaining the highest standards of care.

description_html:
Dr. Mrinmoy Mitra is a renowned figure in the field of Pulmonary Medicine in Kolkata. Recently, he has become a Visiting Consultant in the Department of Pulmonology at ILS Hospitals.

With over 13 years of experience in Pulmonology, he specializes in Interventions such as Fibre-optic Bronchoscopy, EBUS, and Thoracoscopy, as well as Respiratory Critical Care.

Dr. Mitra is also an instructor for IDCCM/IFCCM and has numerous publications in both National and International journals. He completed his MBBS from CNMC in 2008, MD in 2013, DNB in 2014, and FNB (Critical Care) in 2018.

name: Dr. Gotam Pipara
description_html:
Dr Gotam Pipara is an Urologist attached with ILS Hospitals group and has an experience of over 7 years in this field. Dr. Gotam Pipara Has Done His M.B.B.S From The Prestigious M.S.Ramaiah Medical College, Bangalore Karnataka. Thereafter He Pursued M.S. In General Surgery From The Same Institute Under The Able Guidance And Mentorship Of Dr. Sreevatsa M.R. He Was A State Rank Holder During His Final Exams Of M.S. General Surgery In Karnataka. He also holds MCh (Urology) and FRCS from Edinburg. He specialises in Endourology, Genitiurinary, Andrology, Erectile dysfunction and CKD Surgeries including AVF creation.

Areas of expertise:

  • Endourology
  • Urooncology
  • Prostrate surgeries
  • Laparoscopic urology
  • Laser stone surgery ( URS , PCNL , RIRS )
  • Andrology , male
  • Infertility and sexual medicine

Language:

  • English
  • Hindi
  • Marwari
  • Gujrati
  • Kannada
  • Bengali
